messages:
Anya: Ok team — launching co-marketing with CloudLoom next month. Need a launch lane that covers the marketplace listing, a joint webinar, and a short benchmark narrative. Quick owners?
Jordan: I can own marketplace listing copy + assets. ETA Tue 7/9 for copy and screenshots. Will need final demo video from Miguel.
Miguel: I’ll prep the demo video and a 2-min benchmark clip. What perf numbers do we want highlighted? (median latency, cost delta, and recommended config)
Rachel: Webinar logistics — I can handle registration, partner comms, and speaker invites. Proposed date: Thu 7/18 @ 10am PT. Good for everyone?
Ben (Design): I’ll create a hero image + 3 social card sizes. Need partner logos and the webinar title to lock visuals. Will mock A/B hero variants.
Jordan: For inbound routing — marketplace leads -> HubSpot form `marketplace_inbound`, add tag `cloudloom_co-marketing`, route to sales queue "integrations" and assign to Jordan for the first 48 hrs.
Anya: Can we lock landing page copy by 7/10 so design + dev can ship? Also need the benchmark narrative: one short TL;DR for the blog + a technical appendix for the docs.
Jordan: Yep. Draft copy by 7/9. TL;DR will call out: 30% lower per-token cost with caching/batching, 2x lower p95 latency vs baseline, and suggested quantization profile.
Rachel: Webinar promo plan: partner email, our PLG list email, 3 organic social posts, and one paid boost. Recording gated behind a form. A/B CTA test: "See demo" vs "Get the benchmark" — prefer to pick one after first email.
Ben (Design): Uploaded initial hero concepts to Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz — @Anya drop feedback there and I’ll iterate.
launch-bot: HubSpot workflow `marketplace_inbound` created and test webhook fired — status OK.
Miguel: Dev routing snippet for the landing page (put in <head>):
```
<script>
window.redwoodLead = {source: 'cloud_marketplace', campaign: 'cloudloom_launch'};
fetch('/api/track', {method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify(window.redwoodLead)});
</script>
```
Rachel: Also need compliance note for partner demo data (no PII). Legal pinged — @legal said they’ll review the script and demo checklist by EOD Friday.
Anya: Great. Next steps & owners: Jordan — final copy 7/9; Miguel — demo + clip 7/12; Rachel — webinar outline + invites 7/11; Ben — design comps 7/13. I’ll create a single Trello card with all assets + ship calendar invites. :rocket:
